_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round 15 fixed input. THE ONE CARRIER of the record shape (S85). ONE cell, cut on 1.0.0_SA_CTO's L10 round-14 analysis @7761d31eaf (msg 98247). Round 14 STANDS; both judgment criteria PASS accepted; no PRD addendum owed.

the_cell.verbatim: THE RETIRED-DISCRIMINATOR SWEEP, as its own cell. The repair BREAKS ANY INSTRUMENT THAT READS THE POPULATION OFF THE RENDERED TABLE'S BRACES -- 3.0.0_SA_CVO named this against its own convenience, including the instrument IT used minutes earlier, which would now return a clean denominator-bearing 0. Cut a cell that enumerates those instruments and re-points or retires each. ITS ACCEPTANCE ARM IS A POSITIVE CONTROL: each re-pointed instrument must still return round 13's 1303 on the raw rows -- because a ZERO is exactly what a broken one will report.
the_cell.what_round_14_did_that_created_this: EN-r-7 routed every column of the population report through ONE renderer under ONE rule (escape-everywhere). That was the correct repair and the analysis accepted it. Its side effect is that NO COLUMN IS DISTINGUISHED ANY MORE BY CARRYING BRACE BYTES -- which is exactly what the round-13 arm used to identify R-38's population.
the_cell.so_the_hazard_is_a_SILENT_ZERO: an instrument that counted brace-carrying rows now counts ZERO and reports it with a clean denominator. It does not error. It does not warn. IT AGREES WITH ITSELF.

the_standing_bar_this_round_ESTABLISHES.claim: held -- 1.0.0_SA_CTO @7761d31eaf, stated as a standing bar with its cost and non-application
the_standing_bar_this_round_ESTABLISHES.statement: A repair that RETIRES a discriminator names the instruments that used it, IN THE SAME RECORD.
the_standing_bar_this_round_ESTABLISHES.non_application: a repair that ADDS a signal without removing one

the_positive_control_IS_the_criterion.claim: held -- the CTO's own sentence, made mechanical
the_positive_control_IS_the_criterion.why_a_plain_pass_is_worthless_here: the failure mode of every instrument in this sweep is to return a CLEAN, DENOMINATOR-BEARING ZERO. An arm that only checked 'the instrument runs and reports a number' would grade a broken instrument GREEN. So the arm demands the NUMBER: every RE-POINTED instrument returns round 13's 1303 against the raw rows.
the_positive_control_IS_the_criterion.and_1303_is_not_arbitrary: it is the figure round 13 measured (1303 of 3264 judged rows) and round 14's EN-p-38 re-derived from a pinned input while reconciling 1449 by-token against it. Two rounds agree on it by different routes.
the_positive_control_IS_the_criterion.an_instrument_that_CANNOT_return_1303: is not re-pointable and belongs in RETIRED with a basis -- that is an honest outcome and has its own positive arm.

the_enumeration_must_be_a_SUBTRACTION.claim: held -- Rule 24, and this project's own S104/S106 history
the_enumeration_must_be_a_SUBTRACTION.statement: The instrument set is written as a printed DENOMINATOR minus what the sweep excludes, never as a forward list of the instruments anybody remembers. A forward list covers what its author had in mind and omits in silence.
the_enumeration_must_be_a_SUBTRACTION.and_the_denominator_must_be_the_CLAIM'S_: the sweep's subject is 'instruments that read the population off the rendered table', so the denominator is the set of instruments that READ THAT TABLE AT ALL -- not the set of files anybody thought to check. One unscoped read over the corpus, denominator printed, before the subtraction runs.
the_enumeration_must_be_a_SUBTRACTION.the_CVO's_own_instrument_is_IN_SCOPE_and: 3.0.0_SA_CVO surfaced this against its own convenience, naming the instrument IT used minutes earlier. A sweep that omits the adjudicator's own instrument has excluded the one member the analysis explicitly cited.

ZERO_IS_AN_ADMISSIBLE_ANSWER_HERE_TOO.statement: If the sweep finds that NO instrument read the population off the braces, that is a RESULT and it PASSES, with its own positive arm. What is refused is an empty instruments list with no denominator behind it, or an arithmetic that does not close.
ZERO_IS_AN_ADMISSIBLE_ANSWER_HERE_TOO.why_this_matters_more_than_usual: the cell is being asked to find breakage caused by a repair this fabric just accepted. A bar that only passed on finding breakage would be an instruction to find some.

stale_proof_bar.claim: held -- the repaired predicate with both residuals
stale_proof_bar.statement: SET EQUALITY against the proofs that could actually be stale; the COUNT is informational; a failed retrieval RAISES; ONE ordered git log over all watched paths.

what_this_round_does_NOT_quote.the_row: STOP QUOTING A DERIVED TOTAL IN AN ORDER -- the run prints its own. A number an order quotes about its own instrument is a SECOND carrier of a fact the instrument already reports.
what_this_round_does_NOT_quote.measured_breach: all THREE of this seat's LGCTFM round-7 orders quote an arm count, 3 of 3, and so did all three spawn prompts. Found by the cell that was routing that very row.
what_this_round_does_NOT_quote.applied_here: THIS round's order names the self-test SUBCOMMAND and the VERDICT TOKEN it must print, and NEVER the number of arms. This is the first cut where the remedy could apply, and it applies.
